title: MV Show a message in Menu Screen ( RPG Maker MV )

posts.author: Vyndicate
posts.body:
So I was planning to show a message in Menu Screen. How to do it? I've been search but quite confused how to make it work
For context, I was create a custom formation menu where specific hero cannot be main party and it will show the message that you can't place it on main party if it's still want to change it
I also try to use SRD HUD but it didn't work

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
do you mean a popup info that you cannot change actors?
or where do you want to show it?

posts.author: Vyndicate
ShadowDragon
posts.body:
if you want a window, you need to call a window scene for it.
or try to add a gradientfill if possible.
I don't know how that works inside a sprite, but you can make a rectangle in a different way or filler.
but I think you could find that too.
another way it to make the actor name greyed out for swapping for visibility, and instead of text,
a buzzer sound (which could be cleaner too) or use both.
see what works best
